summary: First end-to-end test of the Grove CRM MVP. Backend pytest suite (9/9 passing) covering auth/me with and without bearer, leads CRUD, status filter, search, dashboard stats, and cross-user isolation. Frontend Playwright covered Login render, dashboard with seeded session_token cookie, Add Lead, Search, Status filter, Edit, Delete (with confirm dialog), and Logout (via user-menu-trigger -> logout-button). All flows passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: POST /api/leads returns Lead but does not set HTTP 201 (uses default 200). Minor REST nit; not blocking.
server.py: get_current_user accepts Bearer fallback which is great for testing; ensure this is intentional for production exposure.
Dashboard.jsx: api error paths swallowed silently (catch (_) {}). Consider surfacing fetch errors with toast for better UX.
Logout in AuthContext: ensure it deletes server-side session and clears cookie regardless of API success (verified by current logout flow behavior).
LeadFormDialog: email field is type=email but server-side does not validate email format (Pydantic str). Consider EmailStr in LeadCreate/LeadUpdate.
test_credentials: No real Google account needed. Sessions provisioned directly via mongosh into test_database (users + user_sessions). Used Authorization: Bearer for API and session_token cookie for Playwright per /app/auth_testing.md.
seed_data_creation: Created two test users (TEST_user_A_*, TEST_user_B_*) in pytest fixtures and one FE tester user via mongosh; all cleaned up after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_crm_backend.py (uses MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from /app/backend/.env). For frontend, seed a row in users + user_sessions with a session_token then add it as a secure SameSite=None cookie on the public host before navigating to /dashboard. Logout is hidden behind data-testid='user-menu-trigger' (must be clicked first to open dropdown), then 'logout-button'.
rca of the issue: N/A - no issues found in MVP.
